questions.question: True or False: Erling Haaland scored back-to-back Premier League hat-tricks in both the 2022–23 and 2024–25 seasons.
questions.anchorClues: Erling Haaland scored consecutive hat-tricks against Crystal Palace and Nottingham Forest in August 2022, and repeated the feat against Ipswich Town and West Ham United in August 2024.

questions.question: Which player holds the record for the most assists in a single 38-match Premier League season, sharing the mark of 20 with Kevin De Bruyne?
questions.anchorClues: Thierry Henry set the original single-season assist record during the 2002–03 campaign for Arsenal, which was later matched by Manchester City's Kevin De Bruyne in 2019–20.

questions.question: Which club holds the record for the lowest points total in a single 38-match Premier League season?
questions.anchorClues: Derby County ended the 2007–08 season on just 11 points (1 win, 8 draws, 29 defeats), suffering the lowest tally in Premier League history.

questions.question: Who was the first goalkeeper to score a goal in Premier League history?
questions.anchorClues: Peter Schmeichel volleyed home for Aston Villa against Everton in October 2001 to become the first goalkeeper to find the net in the Premier League.

questions.question: Who was the manager when Leicester City completed their 5000–1 title victory in the 2015–16 season?
questions.anchorClues: Claudio Ranieri famously led Leicester City to their unbelievable Premier League triumph in 2015–16, finishing 10 points clear at the top.

questions.question: Who scored the fastest hat-trick in Premier League history, taking just 2 minutes and 56 seconds?
questions.anchorClues: Sadio Mané scored three times in under three minutes for Southampton against Aston Villa in May 2015, breaking Robbie Fowler's long-standing 1994 record.

questions.question: Who remains the only player to score 100 or more Premier League goals for two different clubs?
questions.anchorClues: Alan Shearer scored 112 Premier League goals for Blackburn Rovers and 148 for Newcastle United, making him the sole player to century-mark at two clubs.

questions.question: Which player holds the all-time record for the most substitute appearances in Premier League history?
questions.anchorClues: James Milner stands atop the table for the most appearances made off the bench in Premier League history, surpassing Peter Crouch's mark of 158.

questions.question: During Arsenal's undefeated 2003–04 Premier League season, how many matches did they draw?
questions.anchorClues: Arsenal recorded 26 wins and 12 draws across their 38 fixtures to accumulate 90 points as 'The Invincibles'.

questions.question: Who was the first outfield player to play every single minute of a Premier League title-winning campaign?
questions.anchorClues: Gary Pallister played all 3,780 minutes of Manchester United's inaugural 1992–93 Premier League-winning season.
